# A02-S34: Model budget

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

Thank you so much for the talk today, it made me extremely happy and gave me many new ideas. I'm looking forward to getting started, to experiment and produce on a large scale.

I have a deadline for my PhD application this Wednesday, which is currently taking quite a bit of time. Luckily, it is super relevant for the work I am about to start with you. However, I would like to carefully identify the points in the budget for which we could apply for funding from foundations, and I have also got a couple of new practice ideas that I think fit well with the residency structure. Would it be okay with you if I send you an updated project proposal by the end of next week at the latest?

Overall, I have a good idea of what we can do. With the current budget, I think JULINA will become a fine-tuned GPT-3 model, and then we set up some simple bots on e.g. Discord and Twitter. If we want to build an actual conversational chatbot for the website, then we'll need production support from the Danish Arts Foundation. Additionally, we should be able to hold voter meetings and a workshop with support from Høje Taastrup municipality.

I'm also ready to participate in other events with you. Just write :-)
